description: This file defines the MonkeyThrottleEvent class used in Android's 'monkey' command to simulate throttle events by pausing execution for a specified duration.

classes.name: MonkeyThrottleEvent
classes.description: A class representing a throttle (sleep) event in the Monkey testing framework, which pauses execution for a specified duration.

methods.name: MonkeyThrottleEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specified throttle duration.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the throttle event by pausing the current thread for the specified duration, and logs the event if verbose mode is enabled.
